title: Normalize profile display names at the presentation boundary
body:
# Normalize profile display names

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Rendered profile display names are trimmed and lowercased at the presentation boundary.
  The stored identifier and source profile data remain unchanged.

- [ ] The existing renderProfile consumer uses the normalized display value without changing the identifier.

- [ ] Add regression evidence through the real renderProfile consumer without adding a dependency.

## Affected Files
- `src/profile.mjs`
- `src/render.mjs`
- `test/display.test.mjs`

## Relevant decision
Apply the prior decision in `docs/decisions/display-boundary.md` and mention how it affected the implementation.
